info.value: ... kzamAyAM yO , marzenmarzeta marzayet . mfzyate mfzyatIti syAt snehane Sapi marzati ' (Slo. 173) iti devaH .

examples: 'na tatte agne pra mfze nivartanaM yad dUre sannihABavaH' (f0 3.9.2).
'vihitaM mayA'dya sadasIdamapamfzitamacyutArcanam' (SiSu॰15.46) ityatra apamfzitamasoQamityarTa iti malliH. upasargavaSAd viparItArTateti ca saH.
'sarvataH samupetasya tava (daSagrIvasya) tenABimarzaRam' (rA0 6.111.8). aBimarzaRaM prasahanaM parABavaH.
'mA no agne sararUpA pitryARi pra marzizWA aBi viduzkaviH san' (f0 1.71.10).
'yatra suparRAH… animizanto vedanenABisvarantIti vA'BiprayantIti vA' (ni0 3.12.1). aBiprayanti=ABimuKyena prayAnti.
'syAtsvalpaH saNkaraH saparihAraH sapratyavamarzaH kuSalasya nApakarzAyAlam' (sAM0 ta0 kO0 udDftaM paYcaSiKasUtram). pratyavamarzo'kAmena sahanam.
'sEnDavaM yena rAjAnaM paryAmfzitavAnaTa' (BA0 vi0 5.23). kaRWe jagrAha, jitavAnityarjunamiSraH. pUrvo'rTastu mfSereva Gawata iti mohamuktavAMzwIkAkAraH.
